title: Auth events could not be found on joining room

labels.name: X-Needs-Info
labels.description: This issue is blocked awaiting information from the reporter

body:
### Description

I have a `server_a` with whitelisted domains and `server_b` that allows everything. The whitelist of `server_a` is as follows:
```
- `server_a_domain`
- `server_b_domain`
- `matrix.server_b_domain`
```
Accepting an invitation from `@user_a:server_a` to an **existing** `server_a` room as `@user_b:server_b` results in:
`Auth events could not be found` 

The error message on the client of  `@user_b:server_b` is: `[HTTP/2 403 Forbidden]` (Element Web). Strangely when creating a new room on `server_a` and invite the user from `server_b` the user joins the room successfully.
